comment: One driver-based rolling plan. `actualsThroughMonthOffset` must be strictly before `startsOnMonthOffset` (planService.createPlan throws 422 otherwise). Budget figures deliberately diverge from seeded actuals in BOTH directions - marketing is underspent, contract delivery labour is overspent - because a budget-vs-actual where everything is favourable proves nothing, and BoardDeck's four board sections collapse to zeros if the variance is one-sided. Shapes here mirror services/forecaster/forecastLineService.ts's CreateForecastLineInput union and headcountService.ts's CreateHeadcountRoleInput exactly: a DRIVER_PRODUCT line needs a COUNT quantity driver and a CENTS rate driver, and a DRIVER_PERCENT line needs a CENTS source driver plus its own percentBps - the percentage lives on the line, not in a BPS driver.

plan.name: FY Operating Plan
plan.description: Driver-based operating plan covering the current quarter.

budget.comment: Compiled from the build-up above, then approved so the freeze trigger - this app's only immutability trigger - is demonstrable. Every manual line carries a non-blank justification because the migration's CHECK requires one: that is what makes the budget zero-based rather than last year plus five percent.
budget.label: FY Operating Budget v1

manualLines.justification: Annual statutory audit plus two contract reviews, quoted by Ashfield Legal LLP.
Office consumables held at the current run rate; no headcount-driven increase assumed.
